_note: TM catalog (§6.4.1, §7.5, docs/design/catalogs/tms.md). A TM is applied from the Map View and permanently adds its move to a compatible Pokémon's Learned Move Pool — it never enters the combat consumable pile. Single use. v0.3 ships the three whose moves already exist; the remaining twelve land with the Shop in v0.4. `compatibleSpecies` is the catalog's list narrowed to the species this build actually has.

tms.name: TM04 Flamethrower
tms.description: A Fire beam that reaches any slot and leaves a Burn behind it more often than it looks.

tms.name: TM05 Surf
tms.description: A wave across the whole enemy line. The only Cleave most Water types will ever hold.

tms.name: TM07 Earthquake
tms.description: Hits every occupied slot for full damage. Expensive, and worth it against a wide team.
